method: dumpsys battery unplug; reset batterystats; execute local scheduled work; inspect UID attribution

permissions.android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS: temporarily granted for Broker approval testing, then revoked and verified granted=false

app_ops: Location, contacts, call and SMS records, calendar, camera, microphone, body sensors, storage/media, Bluetooth scan/connect, activity recognition, nearby Wi-Fi and biometrics operations were observed as ignored. Overlay/accessibility-related operations reported allow; this is not an all-AppOps-denied result.
interpretation: This short, screen-on, simulated-unplug sample is dominated by the display. It does not isolate background CPU energy, predict runtime, or prove zero network egress. Do not interpret the GPU estimate as CPU-only work. No defensible compute-only mAh estimate was obtained.
cleanup: Battery simulation was reset after sampling; device returned to AC powered, USB false, 100% level. Airplane mode was disabled after the offline test.
